en: Colorized panoramic view of a small Central European village in a valley surrounded by green hills and fields. The settlement consists of farmhouses and village buildings with red and gray roofs, scattered along winding dirt roads and amid trees. The lower margin contains printed German text identifying the location and the publisher, along with a note that it is a hand-colored artist card.
